economic_hypothesis: A published low-volatility effect has a positive long leg; test whether it improves the worst profitable development year while lowering realized volatility.

candidate.factor: sample standard deviation of 36 complete monthly simple returns, annualized by sqrt(12)
candidate.history: 37 consecutive explicit month-end prices including formation month
candidate.selection: lowest floor(eligible/10) volatility; instrument-code ascending breaks ties
candidate.formation: last explicit exchange session of prior month; no skipped recent month
candidate.weighting: equal target weights at each month start

universe: historical CSI500 mainland ordinary-board SH60/SZ00 memberships as of formation; no current-roster survivor filter

admission.current_formation_volume_and_factor: positive; no missing monthly prices or zero-variance histories

control: equal-weight the exact same historically eligible names, same execution/fees/risk budget
adaptation_limits: CSI500 main-board subset instead of MSCI universe
equal weights instead of value weights
long only, no full-sample beta leverage
next-session open proxy after formation close

decision.wake: one per exchange session; rebalance only first session of month
decision.quantity: previous marked equity and previous normalized close/factor; buy in visible 100-share lot equivalents
decision.trade_ordering: deterministic sells before buys, sorted by instrument
decision.unfilled: keep original intent and zero fill; no reselection based on execution-session status
decision.full_exit: Known inventory is sufficient to issue a full SELL; do not invent a current price when no target weight remains.
decision.runtime_basis_check: Every monthly decision equity and inventory must equal the original preceding-close account record; initial decision uses registered initial cash.

execution.limit_proxy: direction-specific 9.5% opening return versus previous adjusted close

development_gate: Both full 2024/2025 net >0; mean exposure >=90%; worst-year net > eligible EW control; lower annualized daily net volatility than that control; no unexplained held marks after independent suspension verification.
amendment_stage: Before any completed portfolio outcome was available; 2026 not opened
amendment_reason: Real confirmed suspensions caused missing prior closes. Full exit quantities use known inventory; valuation accepts only independently verified suspension marks matching the last visible close. No price interpolation or provider mutation.

valuation.priced_day: original provider close required to be positive
valuation.unpriced_day: independent same-day tradestatus=0, independently aligned last visible raw close, and ledger mark exactly equal to that last visible normalized close
valuation.unknown_gaps: reject development gate; never treat missing data as suspension
